headline: NVIDIA Maps Enterprise Meaning for Agents
lede: Auto-Ontology turns scattered schemas, columns, and joins into a governed semantic layer. With PostgreSQL, pgvector, and inspectable SQL reasoning, agents can query business data without inventing definitions or relationships.

headline: Skills Put Engineering Discipline Inside Coding Agents
lede: This modular toolkit gives coding agents repeatable practices for TDD, domain modeling, and requirements alignment. Its installable commands create a deliberate feedback loop between fast generation and sound software architecture.

headline: gstack Builds a Virtual Engineering Department
lede: Twenty-three role-based commands move an AI coding agent from product discovery through review, browser QA, security, and release. The toolkit gives small teams a repeatable operating model without staffing every specialty.

headline: An AI Watcher Hunts Xianyu Listings
lede: ai-goofish-monitor turns second-hand marketplace searches into scheduled experiments with browser automation and multimodal analysis. Define a natural-language target, then let concurrent tasks, filters, and notifications surface candidates as they appear.

headline: Scrapling Makes Difficult Websites Crawlable
lede: Scrapling unifies HTTP fetching, browser automation, parsing, concurrency, and export in one Python framework. Adaptive selectors, proxy rotation, session state, and Cloudflare handling aim to keep production crawls moving as pages change.

headline: Agents Control Desktops Through Accessibility Trees
lede: Agent Desktop replaces fragile pixel matching with structured native accessibility data across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Its observe–act–observe loop, stale-reference detection, and Rust core give computer-use systems a stricter control surface.

headline: Worktrunk Tames Parallel Git Worktrees
lede: Worktrunk makes multiple Git worktrees feel like ordinary branch switching from the shell. Pick workspaces interactively, share build caches, and let hooks handle setup while coding agents work in isolated directories.

headline: LZ4 Keeps Compression Near Memory Speed
lede: LZ4 trades compression density for extraordinary throughput, with a high-compression mode when smaller output matters. Its portable C APIs, streaming frames, dictionaries, and command-line utility keep the library useful from databases to operating systems.

headline: Google Catalogs Skills for Cloud Operations
lede: Google’s skills repository assembles reusable agent guidance for IAM, GKE, databases, networking, observability, security, and AI. Install only the domains you need, then update them as cloud workflows evolve.

headline: agent-browser Gives Agents a Usable Web View
lede: agent-browser compresses websites into accessibility trees with stable references that agents can inspect and act on from the shell. Persistent sessions, authentication, downloads, screenshots, and Rust-native binaries turn browser control into a practical interface rather than a pixel puzzle.
